note.en: One-shot by MiniMax M3.1 Flash (thinking intensity: Ultra) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt, answering the repository's canonical Chinese prompt verbatim. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained SVG (about 20 KB, XML-valid): a sunset seashore with a pelican riding a bicycle, wet-sand reflection, speed lines and kicked-up sand, all drawn in code, with the tyres, spokes, crank and pedals as vector geometry. Three rounds of headless-browser render review followed generation and fixed four geometric defects: the handlebars and saddle were completely hidden behind the pelican's body, so the bar stem was raised and pushed forward and the wing tip now grips the right grip; the gular pouch was a thin ribbon that read as a tongue and was redrawn as a full sagging pouch hanging from the base of the bill; the tail was an arrow-shaped silhouette and became five overlapping feathers with shafts; the legs were plain rectangular bars and became thin tarsi with three-toed webbed feet and feathered thighs. All fixes are geometric only and introduce no external resource.

note.en: One-shot by MiniMax M3.1 Flash (thinking intensity: Ultra) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt, answering the repository's canonical Chinese prompt verbatim. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained HTML page (about 46 KB; Three.js r160 via the unpkg CDN with a jsDelivr fallback, all movement assembly, material and lighting code inline and no external assets): a procedurally assembled skeleton watch with a visible mainspring of about 11.5 turns, its barrel, a 34-tooth ratchet wheel, a four-stage train, a 15-tooth escape wheel with a Swiss lever pallet fork carrying two ruby stones, a rose-gold balance wheel with a 13-turn blued-steel hairspring, an Incabloc-style shock absorber, three Cotes de Geneve bridges with 21 ruby jewels, a domed sapphire crystal, luminous hour markers and blued-steel hands; interaction includes hand-written orbit controls, an exploded view, hover labels and click-to-pin detail panels for 18 part groups, a movement run toggle and a view reset. Four rounds of headless-browser (Edge with SwiftShader) render review followed generation and fixed four defect groups: the orbit camera mapped its spherical angles wrongly, so the watch was seen almost edge-on; the three bridges were extruded from shapes whose winding differed, leaving their top faces pointing away and rendering as black slabs, and were rebuilt from rotated box bars and cylindrical bosses; the strap lost its curvature and became a flat slab, and was bent per-vertex with a buckle added; and the studio environment map was too dark for the flat metal surfaces to catch reflections, so the PMREM background was brightened, extra softboxes were added and the metalness/roughness were retuned.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy 编码智能体 Harness 中以 MiniMax M3.1 Flash（思考强度：极致）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词，按仓库标准中文提示词逐字作答。产出为单文件自包含 HTML（约 40 KB；Three.js r160 经 unpkg CDN 引入并附 jsDelivr 回退，其余全部内联）：Perlin 噪声驱动的可滚动体素地形，22 种方块、程序化生成的 16×16 像素贴图图集（含草/土/石/沙/木/叶/黑曜石/水晶/大理石/金/砖/萤石/苔石/符文石/深木/岩浆/冰/符文金等），第一人称 WASD 与指针锁定环视、重力跳跃、逐格碰撞与自动上台阶、DDA 体素射线拾取的破坏与放置、按面剔除的区块网格与顶点级环境光遮蔽、昼夜循环天空着色器、雾与云、快捷栏与 HUD。地形按高度与湿度划分雪原/高山/海岸/森林/平原/丘陵六种群系，并内置七类神话建筑：世界之树、浮空神殿、巨石环阵、阶梯金字塔、残破柱廊、持杖巨像与地下结晶洞窟，按 64×64 区块的确定性哈希分布。生成后经无头浏览器（Edge 配 SwiftShader）复核并修复四处缺陷：其一，图集构建函数未平移画布，24 个图块全部叠画在同一个 16×16 像素格里，导致所有方块都采样到同一贴图，改为逐格平移后绘制；其二，逐面 UV 数组退化（四个角只用了两个不同 UV 坐标），侧壁出现明显条纹，改为每个面独立给出四角 UV，并启用顶点色环境光遮蔽；其三，建筑类型的阈值区间把世界之树与浮空神殿两种类型完全排除在外（实际只生成五类），调整阈值使七类建筑都能生成；其四，初始出生点落在树干内部，改为螺旋搜索半径 4 格内无遮挡的开阔地作为出生点。
note.en: One-shot by MiniMax M3.1 Flash (thinking intensity: Ultra) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt, answering the repository's canonical Chinese prompt verbatim. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained HTML page (about 40 KB; Three.js r160 via the unpkg CDN with a jsDelivr fallback, everything else inline): a Perlin-noise scrollable voxel world with 22 block types and a procedurally drawn 16x16 pixel atlas (grass, dirt, stone, sand, logs, leaves, obsidian, crystal, marble, gold, brick, glowstone, moss stone, rune stone, dark wood, lava, ice, gold-rune and more), first-person WASD with pointer-lock look, gravity and jumping, cell-accurate collision with step-up, DDA voxel raycasting for breaking and placing, face-culled chunk meshes with per-vertex ambient occlusion, a day-night sky shader, fog, clouds, a hotbar and a HUD. Terrain is split into six biomes by height and moisture, and seven kinds of mythic structure are built in: a world tree, a floating sky temple, a monolith circle, a stepped ziggurat, a ruined colonnade, a staff-bearing colossus and an underground crystal cavern, distributed by a deterministic hash over 64x64 regions. Review in a headless browser (Edge with SwiftShader) followed generation and fixed four defects: the atlas builder never translated the canvas, so all 24 tiles were painted into the same 16x16 pixel cell and every block sampled the same texture, which is now drawn per cell with a translation; the per-face UV arrays were degenerate, with the four corners sharing only two UV coordinates, which produced visible striping on the side walls, and each face now carries its own four-corner UV with vertex-colour ambient occlusion enabled; the structure type threshold excluded the world-tree and sky-temple types so only five of the seven kinds ever generated, and the threshold was widened so all seven appear; and the initial spawn landed inside a tree trunk, so the spawn now searches a spiral for open ground with no obstruction within four blocks.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy 编码智能体 Harness 中以 MiniMax M3.1 Flash（思考强度：极致）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词，按仓库标准中文提示词逐字作答。交付为完整的 Vite + React 18 + TypeScript（strict）+ three.js 工程，地图、角色、武器与音效全部程序化生成，不使用任何外部资产。地图为 64×64 可行走单元格网格，完整包含 T 出生点、CT 出生点、A 大、A 点、中门（含可穿过的门体）、猫道、B 洞、B 点，并由洪水填充保证八区连通。角色为程序化类人型：头、躯干、双臂（上臂＋前臂）、双腿（大腿＋小腿）各自独立几何体，CT 与 T 以六种配色区分，持枪姿态且武器随朝向移动。武器为数据驱动表：AK-47、M4A4、AWP、Glock-18、USP-S、沙鹰与近战刀，主/副/近战三槽切换，AWP 右键开镜（3D 拉近＋2D 遮罩）；命中按头/胸/腹/臂/腿五分区结算，爆头为身体伤害两倍，护甲按 armorPen 减伤。回合与 C4：手枪局开局，下包 3.2 秒、爆炸倒计时 40 秒、拆包 10 秒，持包者阵亡掉包可被拾取，未下包时清空对方即获胜，阵亡后可切换视角观战存活队友。AI 为 5v5（玩家＋4 名队友对 5 名进攻方），用网格 BFS 寻路＋字符串拉直，状态机覆盖巡逻、推进、交战、下包与拆包，视线判定基于地图遮挡。HUD 含动态准星、生命/护甲、动态弹药、击杀播报、常驻小地图（Dust2 俯视轮廓＋自己、队友、被看见的敌人与 C4）与 AWP 瞄具遮罩，全部音效由 Web Audio 程序化合成。验证：本机 tsc --noEmit 严格模式零错误，vite build 通过，并以无头浏览器（Edge 配 SwiftShader）实际运行确认无运行时错误，小地图、计分、计时与弹药面板均正常。生成过程中修复三处缺陷：其一，寻路结果的字符串拉直循环在最后一个节点处无法推进，造成死循环并使全部 AI 停止，重写为保证每轮必然前进；其二，AI 的目标选择最初只在小队之间进行，遗漏人类玩家，改为统一的目标获取，敌人玩家同样会被索敌与射击；其三，初始出生朝向正对墙壁，改为朝向地图中心。说明：本环境无 Bun，改用 npm 完成安装与构建；受软件渲染性能限制，无头环境中的长时间观测未能观察到 AI 之间产生击杀，交战与开火逻辑以代码审查与地图连通性校验为准。
note.en: One-shot by MiniMax M3.1 Flash (thinking intensity: Ultra) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt, answering the repository's canonical Chinese prompt verbatim. Delivered as a complete Vite + React 18 + TypeScript (strict) + three.js project in which map, characters, weapons and audio are all generated procedurally with no external assets. The map is a 64x64 walkable-cell grid covering T spawn, CT spawn, Long A, A site, Mid with a passable door gap, Catwalk, B tunnels and B site, with a flood fill guaranteeing that all eight areas are connected. Characters are procedural humanoids with separate geometry for the head, torso, both arms (upper arm plus forearm) and both legs (thigh plus shin); the two sides are told apart by six colour schemes, and the weapon follows the character's facing in a weapon-ready pose. Weapons live in one data table: AK-47, M4A4, AWP, Glock-18, USP-S, Desert Eagle and a knife across primary, secondary and melee slots, with AWP right-click scoping (3D zoom plus a 2D overlay). Hits resolve per zone (head, chest, stomach, arm, leg), headshots count twice body damage and armour reduces damage through a per-weapon penetration value. Rounds and C4: a pistol round opens the match, planting takes 3.2 s, the fuse is 40 s and defusing 10 s, a carrier who dies drops the bomb for a teammate to pick up, wiping the enemy before the plant wins the round, and after death the player can take over a living teammate's view. The AI fields 5v5 (the player plus 4 teammates against 5 attackers) using grid BFS pathfinding with string-pulling and a state machine covering patrol, advance, engage, plant and defuse, with line of sight resolved against map occlusion. The HUD carries a dynamic crosshair, health and armour, a live ammo panel, a killfeed, a persistent minimap (Dust2 top-down outline with yourself, teammates, enemies you can see and the C4) and an AWP scope overlay, and every sound is synthesised with the Web Audio API. Verification: tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors in strict mode, vite build succeeds, and a headless browser run (Edge with SwiftShader) confirms there are no runtime errors and that the minimap, score, timer and ammo panel all render correctly. Three defects were fixed during generation: the string-pulling loop over a finished path could not advance past its final waypoint, which deadlocked and froze every bot, and was rewritten to guarantee progress; bot target selection originally only searched other bots and ignored the human player, so acquisition was unified and the player is now sought and shot at as well; and the initial spawn faced a wall, so the yaw now points at the centre of the map. Disclosure: Bun is unavailable in this environment, so npm was used for installation and builds, and under software rendering the headless observation window was too short to observe AI-versus-AI kills, so engagement and firing logic was checked by code review and map-connectivity validation instead.

note.en: One-shot by MiniMax M3.1 Flash (thinking intensity: Ultra) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt, answering the repository's canonical Chinese prompt verbatim. Delivered as a complete Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + three.js project whose visuals, models, textures and effects are all generated procedurally in code, with no external assets or CDNs. The runtime is 200 seconds, inside the 360-second cap, in four acts — the study conversation between father and son, the airlock suit-up, the assassination outside the hull and a cabin epilogue — across 16 shots with hand-written camera blocking and easing. The art direction is a block/voxel language: figures are assembled from separate head, torso, arm and leg blocks with visors and backpacks, and the sets (shelves, desk, lamp, sea window, corridor light strips, airlock door, exterior platform, handrails, a distant module) are all built from code. All sound is synthesised at runtime with the Web Audio API: machining, servo motors, an indoor gunshot with reverb from a synthetic room impulse, footsteps and impacts, suit breathing, radio, thrusters, depressurisation and alarms. Vacuum physics is respected strictly: the shot outside the hull is only a suit-conducted thump and a subjective low-frequency rumble, with no airborne gunshot at all. Every voice line lives in one structured voiceCues list of 14 entries, each carrying exactly the fields id, kind, speaker, text, delivery, start and end; the subtitles are driven directly from that list and always render bottom-centred as a speaker-tagged line. Disclosure: the repository's cases.json does not attach the source passage, so the film adapts the Zhang Beihai assassination episode named in the case description with entirely original dialogue; Bun is unavailable in this environment, so npm was used for installation and builds; and after the first render check the tone-mapping exposure was raised from 1.06 to 1.28 so that the figures in the study and airlock reads clearly.

note.en: One-shot by MiniMax M3.1 Flash (thinking intensity: Ultra) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt, answering the repository's canonical Chinese prompt verbatim. Delivered as a complete Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + three.js project that uses no external models, textures or audio files, with every visual and every sound generated procedurally at runtime. The short runs 30 seconds and seven caption cards explain the power chain of Su Song's clock tower: the upper reservoir fills, the falling jet strikes the water wheel, the gear train transmits the motion, the escapement is locked by the pendulum, the going train drives the hands, and the lower bucket reports the hour. The key constraint is met: every mechanical motion is computed in real time by a physics engine rather than keyframed or directly assigned. The project ships its own planar impulse-based rigid body solver (src/physics/engine.ts) with gravity integration, pin constraints, gear-ratio angular constraints and angular limits. The water wheel is driven by the continuous torque of the jet, the train is coupled through ratio constraints, the escape wheel is released only while the pendulum's fork is lifted and advances exactly one tooth at a time, the going train drives the hour and minute hands from it, and the reporting bucket grows heavier as it fills, tips over, falls freely and pulls the bell with an impulse derived from its momentum; only the camera move and the captions are choreographed. The picture is a cutaway stone tower: a wooden reservoir, pipe and water column, a paddled water wheel, a brass gear train, the escape wheel with pendulum and hairspring, the reporting bucket, its rope and the bell, the dial and its hands, all built from block geometry. Sound is synthesised with the Web Audio API: the water hiss tracks the reservoir level in real time, a pentatonic bed supplies the music, and the escapement's release click and the bell's long decay are generated on the fly. Verification: tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors in strict mode, the esbuild bundle builds, and a headless browser run confirms there are no runtime errors and that the captions render in the required format. One defect was fixed after generation: the opening camera sat too close to the reservoir and framed only a corner of the box, so it was pulled back and the start/end points of the three-stage move were re-timed. Disclosure: Bun is unavailable in this environment, so npm was used for installation and builds.
